facts.value: Competency requirements may be met with high school work, college work or test scores. Students must earn a minimum 2.00 GPA in each competency area.
Admission may be granted with one deficiency in no more than two competency areas. Deficiencies in both math and laboratory science are not acceptable.

Meet one of the following: Four years of high school English (composition- or literature-based); Minimum test score of 21 on ACT English, or 580 on SAT evidence-based reading and writing; One transferable 3-credit college English composition course.
